referenceMachine.name: Mac mini M6
referenceMachine.label: Base Mac mini M6
referenceMachine.memoryConvention: The nominal 16 GB DRAM configuration is represented as 16 GiB in the RAM model; this is not a measurement of usable memory.
referenceMachine.gpuReferenceLabel: Mac mini M6 CPU + NVIDIA H100 SXM
referenceMachine.gpuBandwidthBasis: NVIDIA H100 SXM peak on-device memory bandwidth: 3.35 decimal TB/s = 3,350 GB/s. PCIe and NVL variants are not substituted. VRAM capacity is descriptive and is not a separate model input.

cpuBenchmark.basis: One published run explicitly identifying the base 12-core CPU / 12-core GPU / 16 GB / 256 GB configuration; not an aggregate or Geekbench 7 conversion.

referenceMachine.interpretation: CPU reference uses the base Mac mini M6 CPU score and 16 GB RAM. GPU reference is a hypothetical basket adding one H100 SXM's memory bandwidth to that host baseline. It is not an actual Mac-with-H100 configuration, a rental quote, or a guarantee of equal application performance.
limitations: The CPU reference is one macOS Geekbench 6.7.1 result on SME-capable hardware; the fitting sample uses compatible Linux results without SME. The target score is an external performance proxy, not a new training observation.

The GPU model uses H100 SXM's theoretical 3,350 GB/s memory bandwidth, not a GPU Geekbench score or VRAM capacity. This exceeds the eligible fitting sample's bandwidth range, so the reference price extrapolates. The hypothetical 16 GB Mac-class host plus one H100 is not an observed cloud shape; marginal input ranges do not establish joint support.
The same reference resource basket is applied to every historical date; it does not describe past Mac mini generations or pre-launch H100 rental prices. Early fits extrapolate to this bandwidth.

methodology.description: Refit the same functional forms to dated public AWS Linux on-demand price catalogs for US East (N. Virginia). This is a provider-specific reconstruction, separate from the current multi-provider reference price.
methodology.cpuFormula: H = A × (RAM/16)^alpha × (Geekbench6/5000)^beta; ordinary least squares of log price on log inputs.
methodology.gpuFormula: P = H + n × k × B; nonnegative k minimizes equal-family mean squared log error of whole-VM price.
methodology.benchmarkBasis: Exact cloud VM shape; measurements were made after the historical price dates. The scores are retrospectively frozen hardware descriptors, not contemporary observations in each year.
methodology.dates: Points use actual archive publication dates. No prices are interpolated or carried into missing years.
methodology.matching: Exact instance name plus matching nominal RAM and vCPU count. No vCPU-to-performance imputation. Prices effective after their source publication are excluded.
methodology.uncertainty: Historical samples vary with catalog and benchmark coverage. Early samples are small; extrapolation and changing composition can move the series. Training diagnostics are not held-out validation. Values are nominal USD without inflation adjustment.
methodology.referenceMeaning: The CPU reference uses Base Mac mini M6, 16 GB RAM and 20,525 Geekbench 6 CPU score. The GPU basket adds one NVIDIA H100 SXM 80 GB HBM3 with 3,350 GB/s on-device memory bandwidth. It estimates cloud resource cost, not actual Mac-with-H100 configurations, past Mac generations or pre-launch H100 rental prices. The score is one macOS/SME-capable result. Early fits extrapolate to this bandwidth. Marginal input-range flags do not establish joint support.
methodology.dailyObservations: Subsequent AWS catalog refreshes append dated current observations; these are not backfilled from present prices.
